_about: Hard-coded colours that are genuine DATA or technical values, not UI chrome. scripts/check-colors.mjs skips them. Everything else must use a token from src/lib/styles/tokens.css. An entry matches a file and, optionally, the exact literal (text), a substring of the line (line) or a regular expression for the trimmed line (lineRegex).

matches.why: legend ramps of two colormaps (diverging, viridis): colormap data
the diverging colour scale of a difference map: colormap data
hydrometeor class colours: each class keeps its own colour in both themes
the accent colour swatches the user can pick: their values are stored in the settings
storm-cell intensity classes (dBZ): data colours, same in both themes
the accent values that count as 'not customised'
computes the text colour on a custom accent colour (needs both literals)
CSS mask: only the alpha matters, not a visible colour
paper colour under the map tiles (goes through the basemap theme filter with the tiles)
default colour of a radar marker without an assigned colour
SVG mask: white shows, black hides; not a visible colour

initial value of a colour input when a look has no colour yet
